goal: Stop socket activity and disconnect immediately when socket polling reports an error
Avoids CPU busy loops on macOS, Windows, and BSD nodes when peers send unreadable urgent data
reviewability: Ready to review, though the author moved the PR to draft to pursue an alternative PR instead
agreement: No reviewers have explicitly endorsed the PR
Concern that halting reads on error disrupts TCP half-close was answered by the author (theuni)
Withdrew a suggestion for a cross-platform poll redesign as out of scope for this change (theuni)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents node threads from spinning in a busy loop when peers send urgent data
Mitigates potential denial of service on select-based platforms like macOS, Windows, and BSDs

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it standardizes socket error handling in the HTTP server to avoid improper polling
The benefit to HTTP reliability is secondary compared to the peer-facing denial of service fix
